insights: For odd positive moduli the Kronecker symbol IS the Jacobi symbol (kronecker_eq_jacobi), so mul-in-n and QR come for free from jacobiSym.mul_right' and jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity.
No coprimality hypothesis is needed for the odd-positive QR: when gcd(m,n)>1 both sides vanish.
The general even/negative case genuinely needs the supplementary laws (2/n) and (-1/n) plus a Gauss-sum/induction combination not yet in Mathlib.
kronecker0_mul had bit-rotted: Int.isUnit_eq_one_or is now IsUnit u -> (u=1 v u=-1), not an iff; use Int.isUnit_iff instead.

kronecker_neg4_values originally claimed (-4/3)=1, which is FALSE: (-4/3)=J(-4|3)=J(2|3)=-1 (2 is a non-residue mod 3); the character of Z[i] has chi(3)=-1. Corrected to -1 and proved via kronecker_eq_jacobi + norm_num's Jacobi-symbol extension.

v4.26 drift: simp now closes the concrete kronecker2/kronecker0 value goals, leaving trailing decide/omega calls dead ('No goals to be solved'); Int.natAbs_ofNat renamed to Int.natAbs_natCast; simp_all case shapes changed under kroneckerNeg1_mul - replaced with explicit if_pos/if_neg + norm_num per sign case.
jacobiSym.mul_right' a (b1 != 0) (b2 != 0) needs ONLY nonzero moduli, not oddness -- so full mul-in-n over nonzero Z is immediate once each kronecker call is normalized to sign(n)*J(a||n|).

Normal-form trick: with three DIFFERENT moduli (m*n, m, n) a direct split_ifs on the kronecker branches explodes; collapse each to sign(n)*J(a||n|) via kronecker_eq_sign_jacobi first, then remaining case work is purely about signs.
Sign multiplicativity across a nonzero product: only the m<0,n<0 case is nontrivial (m*n>0), where the two sign chars cancel via kroneckerNeg1_sq (a value in {+-1} squares to 1).

SCOPE/HONESTY: at even moduli this file's kronecker equals Jacobi's value at 2, NOT the classical mod-8 kronecker2 (defined but never wired into kronecker). So kronecker_mul_right is multiplicativity of the symbol AS DEFINED (matches the classical Kronecker symbol at all odd moduli and at n=+-1). Kept status wip.
